summary: Conjecture 9.2 asserts that a digraph is 2-extremal if and only if it belongs to $\mathcal{H}_2$, the class generated from symmetric odd cycles by directed Hajós joins and 2-Hajós tree joins. This complements the paper's characterization for $k=1$ and $k\geq 3$. No follow-up resolving the $k=2$ case was found in the May 2026 review.
